name: Marayan Thong Peak
tagline: The Crown of Alikadam – 1,650 ft Summit Camping & Matamuhuri River Panoramas
description: Standing tall above the Matamuhuri River basin, Marayan Thong is legendary among serious backpackers for its serene summit Buddhist stupa (Zadi), panoramic cloud-filled sunrises, and magical nighttime stargazing from hilltop tents.
whereToStay: Tents/Camping on summit (Bring own gear or rent from Alikadam town), or basic guest houses at Alikadam Bazaar (উপজেলা সদরের হোটেল). No luxury resorts.

networkStatus.teletalk: Moderate to Strong (সামিটে সবচেয়ে ভালো কাজ করে)
networkStatus.grameenphone: Fair at base, intermittent at peak

bestTime: October to February (Dry, cool camping nights)
localFood: Alikadam hill bazaar paratha, country chicken, and tribal organic wild bananas.

name: Debotakhum Canyon
difficulty: Moderate Trek & Rafting (মাঝারি ট্রেইল ও ভেলা)
tagline: The Green Grotto – Towering 200ft rock walls navigated by quiet bamboo rafts
description: A geological hidden marvel tucked inside Roangchhari. Visitors glide on traditional bamboo rafts through an ancient narrow gorge filled with calm, emerald-green mountain waters enclosed by colossal vertical stone cliffs.
whereToStay: Indigenous homestays at Liangshang Para (মারমা ও তঞ্চঙ্গ্যা আদিবাসী হোমস্টে) or Bandarban town hotels (১ ঘণ্টা দূরত্বে).

networkStatus.teletalk: Weak to No signal inside the gorge

bestTime: November to March (Water is calm, deep green and crystal clear; avoid mid-monsoon flash floods)
localFood: Homestyle boiled mountain vegetables, bamboo shoot mash, and stream fish in banana leaf.

name: Munlai Para Eco Village
tagline: The Cleanest Indigenous Village – Community-run Bawm tribal hospitality
description: Recognized as the cleanest community village in the Chittagong Hill Tracts. Located in Ruma upazila, Munlai Para is an eco-village managed entirely by the indigenous Bawm community featuring wooden treehouses, ziplining, and organic orchards.
whereToStay: Certified Community Homestay Cottages operated by Bawm families (মুনলাই পাড়া কমিউনিটি কটেজ). Very authentic and warm.
bestTime: All year round; especially October to March
localFood: Bawm style roasted chicken with hill herbs, fresh organic papaya salad, and wild ginger tea.

name: Dholai Khal & Bholaganj Stream
bengaliName: ধলাই নদী ও সাদাপাথর গোপন ট্রেইল
tagline: Where Icy Meghalaya Waters Cascade Over Pure White Pebbles
description: Located right at the border of Companyganj, the Dholai river flows down from the clouds of Cherrapunji. While main Sada Pathor sees day trippers, the quiet upper tributaries of Dholai Khal offer pristine calm pools of crystal-clear mountain water and uninterrupted views of Meghalaya's cascading waterfalls.
whereToStay: Sylhet city hotels (1.5 hrs away by AC bus/car) or Companyganj Upazila Dak Bungalow (কোম্পানীগঞ্জ ডাকবাংলো).
bestTime: May to October (Full water current and dramatic Meghalaya cloud cover)
localFood: Sylhet town Akhni Polao, Shatkora beef, and roadside hot Parathas with fried river fish.

name: Pantumai & Sangrampunji
tagline: The Breathtaking Border Cascade & Khasi Punji Betel Nut Groves
description: A tranquil village on the Indo-Bangla frontier where a roaring white cascade (known locally as Fatachhari / Borohil Falls) tumbles down the Meghalaya cliffs into the Piyain River. The neighboring Khasi Punji settlements are surrounded by betel nut forests.
whereToStay: Village homestays or Jaflong / Sylhet city hotels (১.৫ ঘণ্টা দূরত্বে).
bestTime: June to September for full waterfall roar
localFood: Local sweet river fish curry and piping hot tea at Pantumai Bazar.

name: Monpura Island
tagline: The Isolated Island of Sunrises, Mangrove Canals & Wild Buffalo Herds
description: Surrounded by the mighty Meghna estuary, Monpura is an untouched, serene delta island. Famous for its 500-meter scenic wooden landing pier stretching into the river, thousands of grazing water buffaloes, cycling paths, and fresh winter sour-curd (Doi).
whereToStay: Monpura Upazila Dak Bungalow (উপজেলা পরিষদ ডাকবাংলো) or local small guest houses at Hazirhat Bazaar.
bestTime: October to March (Calm winter river waters and cool breezes)
localFood: Pure Buffalo Milk Curd (মহিষের দুধের টক দই), fresh Hilsha fry, and local winter duck curry.

name: Nijhum Dwip & Mangrove Reserve
tagline: The Silent Island – Sanctuary of 40,000 Wild Spotted Deer
description: An isolated island sanctuary in the Bay of Bengal where thousands of wild spotted deer roam peacefully through mangrove Keora forests. Watch flocks of migratory birds at Komolani Beach and sail silent canals at dawn.
whereToStay: Hotel Nijhum Dreamland, Forest Department Rest House (বন বিভাগ রেস্টহাউস), or local eco-cottages at Namar Bazar.
keyAttractions: Spotted Deer Safari in Keora Forest
bestTime: November to February (Mild weather and prime deer spotting)
localFood: Fresh sea Chewa fish, live mud crab curry, and sweet date palm jaggery.

name: Sonar Char & Horinghata Forest
tagline: The Golden Island Beach – Vast sand dunes & untouched coastal mangroves
description: Sonar Char is a virgin, golden sandy beach located where the coastal mangrove meets the Bay of Bengal in Rangabali. Horinghata features a long wooden footbridge through coastal forests where deer and monkeys feed at low tide.
whereToStay: Forest department eco-cottage at Horinghata, or basic Upazila guest houses at Patharghata / Kuakata.
localFood: Fresh Hilsha, dried Loitta fry, and tender coconut water.

name: Dahagram-Angarpota & Teesta Points
tagline: The Historic Enclave Oasis – Tin Bigha Corridor & Peaceful Teesta Sandbanks
description: Access through the historic Tin Bigha Corridor into Bangladesh's largest former enclave. Experience the quiet rural life, vast sandy sandbars of the Teesta River, and warm northern hospitality far away from any commercial noise.
whereToStay: Patgram Upazila Rest House (পাটগ্রাম উপজেলা রেস্টহাউস) or hotels in Burimari / Lalmonirhat.
bestTime: October to March (Golden winter mustard flower season)
localFood: North Bengal delicate Chidwa, fresh Teesta river Baim fish curry, and pure cow milk sweets.

name: Birganj Shalban & Singra Forest
bengaliName: বীরগঞ্জ শালবন ও সিংড়া জাতীয় উদ্যান
tagline: The Northern Deciduous Shal Woods & Forest Walkways
description: A dense natural forest of towering Shal trees, home to peacocks, owls, and migratory wetland birds. The forest floor is criss-crossed by quiet walking trails and peaceful lotus ponds.
whereToStay: Forest rest house (prior permission needed) or Dinajpur Sadar town hotels (40 mins away).
localFood: Dinajpur Kataribhog rice polao, traditional sweet rice cakes (Pitha).
